title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Integrated Towel Bar Solid Brass | Shaded Beige | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Towel Bar | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized surface space with a wall mount glass shelf featuring an integrated towel bar and thick tempered glass in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. Designed for bathroom storage above a sink or vanity, this shelf pairs beveled-edge glass with solid brass hardware for enduring everyday use.

Highlights:
- Shaded Beige transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Beveled-edge glass shelf for a clean, finished look
- Solid brass hardware for strength and lasting support
- Part of the Waverly Place Collection for coordinated bathroom accessories

Specs:
- Glass size: 16 x 5 Inches
- Projection: 5 Inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Assembly: No assembly required
- Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Multiple designer finish options available
